description: Provenance manifest for vendored Claude Code skills. Used as the baseline for periodic upstream drift review. Versions are PINNED: skills are a frozen snapshot and never auto-update. The review automation diffs upstream against these vendored copies and reports drift for human approval before any update.
retrievalMethod: codeload.github.com tarball (main branch), git clone is blocked by egress policy

sources.name: andrej-karpathy-skills
sources.notes: Documentation-only guidelines. No executable code or hooks.

sources.name: claude-video
sources.notes: SessionStart hook (check-setup.sh) + Python scripts (yt-dlp/ffmpeg/whisper). Requires yt-dlp, ffmpeg, and optionally Whisper to function.

sources.name: superpowers
sources.notes: Well-known maintainer (Jesse Vincent). NOTE: upstream ships a SessionStart hook (hooks/session-start) that is NOT vendored here; only the skills/ directory was copied.

sources.name: understand-anything
sources.notes: Skills call an npm/TypeScript CLI backend that is NOT vendored. Needs the upstream plugin built (npm/pnpm) to be fully functional.

sources.name: agentmemory
sources.notes: Skills depend on the agentmemory MCP server + npm tool (NOT vendored). Upstream ships hooks (plugin/hooks) that are NOT vendored. Requires separate install + MCP config to function.
